related.title: Skylab 太空實驗室
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：教學流量能力 0.25 kg/s 時新增負載不合格，需降載或改良熱介面。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: With teaching capacity 0.25 kg/s, the new load fails and requires load reduction or improved thermal interface. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 建立單面吸熱模型，區分降低吸收與提高散熱兩種熱控策略。
related.differenceEn: Build a single-face absorption model and distinguish reduced absorption from increased heat rejection.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成熱負載 4000 W、冷卻液比熱 4000 J/(kg K)、允許溫升 5 K。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：ṁ=4000/(4000×5)。 結果約 0.2 kg/s。穩態 Q=ṁcpΔT；忽略相變與對外散熱，單位 W=kg/s×J/(kg K)×K。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成太陽照度 1360 W/m²、受照面積 10 m²、吸收率 0.6、正對太陽。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：Q=0.6×1360×10。 結果約 8160 W。直接日照吸熱 Q=αSAcosθ；只算外部輸入，不等於艙內溫度。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic load is 4000 W, coolant heat capacity 4000 J/(kg K) and allowed rise 5 K. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: ṁ=4000/(4000×5). Result ≈ 0.2 kg/s. At steady state Q=ṁcpΔT, excluding phase change and external loss; W=kg/s×J/(kg K)×K.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic irradiance is 1360 W/m², exposed area 10 m², absorptivity 0.6 and normal incidence. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: Q=0.6×1360×10. Result ≈ 8160 W. Direct solar absorption Q=αSAcosθ calculates input only, not cabin temperature.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: OneWeb 低軌通訊星系
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：教學流量能力 0.25 kg/s 時新增負載不合格，需降載或改良熱介面。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: With teaching capacity 0.25 kg/s, the new load fails and requires load reduction or improved thermal interface. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 估算理想地平線斜距，指出最低仰角、遮擋與地面閘道的額外限制。
related.differenceEn: Estimate ideal horizon slant range and identify additional elevation, blockage and gateway constraints.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成熱負載 4000 W、冷卻液比熱 4000 J/(kg K)、允許溫升 5 K。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：ṁ=4000/(4000×5)。 結果約 0.2 kg/s。穩態 Q=ṁcpΔT；忽略相變與對外散熱，單位 W=kg/s×J/(kg K)×K。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學地球半徑 6371 km、衛星高度 1200 km。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：d=sqrt((6371+1200)²−6371²)。 結果約 4090.28 km。球形地球切線模型 d=sqrt((R+h)²−R²)；只算零仰角幾何，不含大氣折射。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic load is 4000 W, coolant heat capacity 4000 J/(kg K) and allowed rise 5 K. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: ṁ=4000/(4000×5). Result ≈ 0.2 kg/s. At steady state Q=ṁcpΔT, excluding phase change and external loss; W=kg/s×J/(kg K)×K.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Use teaching Earth radius 6371 km and satellite altitude 1200 km. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: d=sqrt((6371+1200)²−6371²). Result ≈ 4090.28 km. The spherical tangent model d=sqrt((R+h)²−R²) gives zero-elevation geometry without refraction.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
